deepdive.sec: Copper products (adjacent to Power/Grid) — semis & value-added

bull_bear.body:
- **Structurally low margins** (copper conversion); earnings highly geared to volume + value-add mix.
- **Corporate complexity / governance optics:** repeated **Company Secretary resignations** (mgmt attributes to poaching of a listed-co CS, not operational); demerger execution risk.
- Copper-price volatility (pass-through but affects optics/working capital).
- Real-estate monetisation timing/uncertainty.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Founder-led (Surana family), promotional tone; ambitious targets (₹5,000cr). Conservative balance sheet (near-zero LT debt). Diversified/complex story (copper + wind + RE + demerger).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- It's really **two stories** post-demerger: a copper-products growth co (Tieramaet) + a residual wind/real-estate value-unlock — value them separately.
- The AI-DC **silver/tin busbar** niche is the genuine high-margin (5–10%) differentiator vs the commodity copper base.
- China is *not* a competitor in copper products (unlike conductors/cables) — a structural positive for this niche.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- A preferential issue of Rs 52.25 crore to non-promoters was approved (Board 30 June 2026, EGM 23 July 2026) - 15,01,434 shares at Rs 348 each (Rs 2 face value plus Rs 346 premium), above the SEBI ICDR floor price.
- Use of proceeds is weighted to working capital (Rs 42.25 crore) with Rs 10.00 crore for general corporate purposes, i.e. funding the volume/mix ramp rather than a large greenfield build.
- Seven investors participated (3 QIB + 4 non-QIB), including Niveshaay Hedgehogs Fund (38.28% of the issue), LC Pharos Multi Strategy Fund and Ashika Global Finance.
- Roughly INR 40 crore of internal capex over FY27-28 sits alongside the equity raise, with further value-added capacity investment phased over 3-5 years.
- The demerger rationale explicitly names 'value unlocking' and 'wider capital access' as objectives.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Copper = new gold": **green energy ~3.5x**, **EV ~4x** more copper vs conventional; AI/data centres power-hungry → copper-intensive. Demand boom seen **10–15 years**.
- Global scrap sourcing (every continent); **500 OEM customers** (electrical, switchgear, autos).
- Aluminium substitution: mostly *already done* over 15 yrs (Cu:Al ratio ~3–3.5); copper retained where reliability/space critical.
business.title: Demand drivers (copper super-cycle)

business.body:
- **Demerger** into a copper co (**Tieramaet Ltd**, new listco, **mirror shareholding** — 1 share per BHAGYANGR share) + residual (wind energy + real estate). Expected FY26–27.
- **Real estate:** 3 industrial land parcels (~₹200–300cr circle-rate); Telangana industrial→commercial conversion policy; ~16 lakh sq ft residential potential at Uppal, ~4 lakh sq ft to the company via JD *without further investment* (targeted before March).

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers (listed names)

business.body:
- Founded in 1985 by Late Shri G.M. Surana and managed by three generations of the Surana family from Hyderabad, with a legacy of roughly 40 years in copper.
- Describes itself as one of the largest secondary copper players in India, riding a structural shift from primary to recycled copper (secondary copper demand CAGR ~11-12% expected FY25-FY30P versus ~5% for total India copper demand).
- Competitive strengths cited are a diversified copper portfolio with rising value-added share, integrated facilities with scalable capacity and advanced technology, and a global sourcing platform serving 500+ customers.
- Serves multiple high-growth end sectors - power transmission, automotive/electrical, refrigeration, infrastructure and solar - with a domestic base complemented by a growing presence in North America, Middle East and Asia.
- Preferred-supplier positioning is evidenced by long-standing relationships with names such as Larsen & Toubro, Amara Raja, V-Guard, Hammond, ReGen Powertech, Sterling & Wilson and OBO Bettermann.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Demerger] A composite, non-severable scheme under Sections 230-232 read with Section 66 has three linked steps: BCPL amalgamates into BIL, the copper business demerges from BIL into Tieramet Ltd on a going-concern basis, and Tieramet lists independently on NSE and BSE.
- [Scheme status] Appointed date is 01 April 2025; Board approved 20.09.2025, NCLT ordered meetings on 29.01.2026, shareholders/banks/creditors/SEBI have approved, ROC-RD-OL reports are filed, and the NCLT hearing was scheduled for 07.08.2026.
- [Entitlement] Entitlement is 1:1 - one new Rs 2 face-value Tieramet share for every BIL share held on the record date, mirroring BIL's shareholding exactly; BCPL's capital is cancelled so BIL's paid-up capital and shareholding are unchanged.
- [Post-scheme split] After the scheme, BIL retains the 9 MW wind mill and three land parcels while Tieramet holds the entire copper business (including erstwhile BCPL), leaving shareholders with two focused, independently listed companies.
- [Certification transfer] The BIS Certification Marks Licence (No. 6300109596, per IS 1897:2008) is currently held by Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited and is to vest in the resulting entity pursuant to the scheme.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: - Heat-recovery systems on furnaces → lower fuel/cycle time. Higher imported-copper mix lifted margin. Value-added shift is the margin lever.

- _Q4 FY26 → check: did Q4 (their "best quarter") land?, EBITDA margin crossing 5%, demerger record date, RE JD signed, busbar export ramp._
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **Growth: ~35–40% FY26, ≥25% FY27.** **₹5,000cr (copper business) by FY28–29** (preponed from 2030).
- **Margins: EBITDA ~5% steady; PAT inching 2% → 3%+** as interest/other costs fall with scale (rating BBB→BBB+, targeting A−; long-term debt ~zero, only WC debt).
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body:
- **AI data-centre busbars (tin/silver-plated copper):** entered the market, **export-led (US + others avoiding China)**, 20+ yr quality edge → low near-term competition; also "biggest player in India" for busbars. Needs marketing push to scale.
- **Solar interconnect wires** (scaled from prototype), **transformer windings** (since 2020).
- **Plastic recycling** byproduct (LDP/PVC granules, pyrolysis) 150 → 500 tons.
- **EU FTA** opens a new export market (no prior EU sales; US tariff 50% but US is a small, specialised slice).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Integrated copper-products maker + **scrap recycler** (commodity → value-add) levered to the copper-demand super-cycle ("copper is the new gold" — AI, EV, green energy). Record 9M (rev +40%, EBITDA +172%) but **structurally thin margins** (EBITDA ~4–5%, PAT ~2%). Two distinct optionalities: (a) **tin/silver-plated busbars for AI data centres** (high-quality, export-led, "biggest player in India"), (b) a **copper-business demerger** (→ *Tieramaet Ltd*, mirror shareholding) + **₹200–300cr real-estate** parcels. Lower-conviction / more-moving-parts than the focused names.
